map.⚠️ 骨吸收程度是牙周炎诊断与预后评估的重要指标。重度骨吸收牙预后较差，需综合评: Bone loss severity is a key indicator for periodontal diagnosis and prognosis. Severe bone loss has a poor prognosis and requires comprehensive assessment of retention value.
map.预后极差，常需拔除: Very poor prognosis, often requires extraction
map.骨吸收% = (根长 - 剩余骨高度) ÷ 根长 × 100%\n剩余骨支持%:
Bone loss % = (root length - remaining bone height) / root length x 100%
Remaining bone support % = remaining bone height / root length x 100%
map.参考：牙周病学（孟焕新）骨吸收程度分级。临床常结合冠根比综合判断。: Reference: bone loss grading in Periodontology (Meng Huanxin). Clinically combined with crown-root ratio.

map.输入：牙根长度 L=13mm，根尖片上剩余骨高度 H=5.2mm\n计算：骨吸收:
Input: root length L=13mm, remaining bone height on film H=5.2mm
Calculation: bone loss ratio = (1 - H/L) x 100% = (1 - 5.2/13) x 100% approx 60%
Determination: > 1/2 of root length indicates grade III bone loss, suggesting significant loss of supporting tissue; implant placement needs bone augmentation assessment.

map.骨吸收和牙周袋深度是一回事吗？: Are bone loss and pocket depth the same?
map.不是。骨吸收反映 X 线上的支持骨丧失，牙周袋深度是探诊软组织深度，二者需结合附: No. Bone loss reflects supporting-bone loss on X-ray, while pocket depth is the soft-tissue probing depth; both must be combined with clinical attachment loss (CAL) to assess periodontal severity.
map.这个比例能代替 X 线诊断吗？: Can this ratio replace X-ray diagnosis?
map.不能。本工具仅为比例估算，确诊依赖根尖片或 CBCT 及牙周探诊；牙齿松动、牙龈: No. This tool is only a ratio estimate; diagnosis relies on periapical film or CBCT and periodontal probing; for loose teeth or gum bleeding, visit a periodontal specialist promptly.
